AUTHOR.description: Record the applicable author decision for the actual material and any required rights approval.

REVIEW.description: Record all applicable independent technical role results and style review for the exact candidate.

SOURCE.description: Verify exact-source orchestration test evidence from the maintained Site Checks source suite. Local Basic does not select that suite.

NATIVE.description: Record separate native worker and critic handles, isolation checks and a fresh correction under issue #217 review evidence.

EVIDENCE.description: Record the two blinded source decisions, the computation-limits case and the author-approved research stop in the private pilot record.

DECISIONS.description: Record actual R1/R2/R-deck/R3 decisions and pre-edit voice evaluations for the author draft and derivative post, plus edit retention.

PUBLISHER.description: In the private pilot record, bind Writing navigation and its missing-selection negative, actual edition PDF inspection, refusal of the stale allowlisted approval, rebuilt article and linked-file SHA-256 readback. Record independent private reflow approval with the thesis decision preserved.

TALKS_POSTS.description: In the pilot record, bind standalone editable PPTX, matched slide and note order, rendered pages, claims and legibility, and talk PDF when requested. Pin the accepted edition before post work, compare unchanged manuscript bytes after post correction, record rights by channel and confirm draft/date/approval yields no publication event.

RECOVERY.description: In controlled run evidence, bind candidate, inputs, attempts, author decisions and a separate current checkpoint to the verified private store. Exercise interruption after dispatch, stop, late result, author edit, stale checkpoint, budget and one external call under concurrent attempts. Inspect the target and verify delayed A cannot replace accepted B.

HANDOFF.description: Record the full package delta and changed PR head refusal before any outward transfer, with separate observations for authorized delivery.

PILOT.description: Record author evaluation, active review/edit time, rewrites, claim corrections and observed costs with the reviewed implementation.
